description: This is a shell script used for automated testing and deployment tasks in a continuous integration environment. It manages git operations, runs build commands, and conditionally updates the gh-pages branch.
external_files: ci environment variables (TRAVIS_BRANCH, TRAVIS_PULL_REQUEST, GH_OAUTH_TOKEN, GH_OWNER, GH_PROJECT_NAME)

methods.name: get_changes
methods.description: Function to determine which framework files have changed based on git diff between current HEAD and origin/master, filtering for example files and extracting framework names.
